verdicts.reason: The two candidates share the same broken layout: the yellow decorative blocks cover the top photo, a large empty yellow slab sits next to a shrunken second photo, the headline has lost its yellow highlight band, and the two name labels are pulled apart with dead space between them. B is slightly worse because its two empty horizontal yellow bars over the woman's photo look like text boxes with the text missing, and its offset yellow frame sticks out behind the second photo. A's arbitrary yellow block covering the right of the top photo is still an obvious flaw.
